evidence.author: Gitanes232
evidence.used: sharp pointed fluted mauve-brown clay pillars of 3-12 m with darker caps standing on an eroded clay wall, clustered in gullies and screened by broadleaf and pine forest
nature reserve extent only (558 m x 216 m): a 90 m group of pillars is modelled

review.gaps: pointed fluted pillars in three gullies on an eroded clay slope with forested hill behind; trees are low-poly and do not screen the pillars as densely as the photo, ground is a flat pad
